sources.description: Spotify Web API, OpenAPI 3.0.3, roughly 30 paths across GET, POST, PUT and DELETE, with an OAuth2 authorization-code scheme and extensive $ref use. Distributed with RestBench, whose 57 instructions carry human-annotated solution paths. Chosen because neither the specification nor the instructions were written by this project, and because its write and delete operations exercise the approval gate, confirmation protocol and least-privilege scope selection that a read-only benchmark would leave untouched.

sources.attribution: RestBench Spotify task set, from the RestGPT repository by Yifan Song and colleagues, MIT licensed. Fetched, never redistributed by this project.
sources.description: RestBench's Spotify task set: 60 natural-language user goals, each with a human-annotated solution path expressed as HTTP method and templated path. Authored by the RestGPT team, not by this project, which is what removes circularity from the goals as well as from the specification.

sources.description: A live public SOAP service published by Data Access Worldwide as a sample, document/literal, with more operations than any WSDL this project has parsed. It is here to test emission against a document nobody here wrote, which the SAWSDL corpus cannot do because it is entirely Section 5 encoded.
